ns0:svg.ns0:text: Biarticular muscles · PF inputs, local reflexes, and physical maps
AD = map / adapter. Brown arrows: physical signals. Open triangles: excitation. Filled circles: inhibition.
Spindle and tendon symbols show encoded signals; muscle→spindle→AD→Ia/II and muscle→force sensor→AD→Ib are explicit.
MN→AD→muscle carries activation. Each muscle retains its own MN, Ia, II, Ib, interneurons, and Renshaw cell.
Gray dashed PF→MN routes have effective g = 0. Central afferent→RG/PF projections are detailed in the preceding RG/PF sheets.
RF: hip flexion + knee extension. SM: hip extension + knee flexion. Both PF inputs terminate on the same muscle MN.
